## Suggested heading topics

**Method and algorithm**

- **Why the method work restarted** — convergence, supervision and bookkeeping problems
- **Rebuild plan** — one model for one or more data blocks, as an R package
- **Model specification and objective** — the Cox term in the ELBO and monotone updates
- **Survival supervision of $F$** — finding low-variance prognostic programs
- **Factor selection and pruning** — program roles from one fit, no refitting
- **What counts as a working method** — criteria to agree on before new experiments

**Multimodal model**

**Data and preprocessing**

- **Preprocessing alignment** — one pipeline for single-modality and multimodal fits

**Feature experiments (waiting on a working model)**

- **Survival-association feature screening** — survival-informed vs. mean/variance screen

**Project housekeeping**
